description:
[REACH Candidate List SVHC 0.1% threshold screener. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits candidate list SVHC concentration by weight (w/w) in complex articles ex ECJ Case C-106/14 (Once an Article, Always an Article), identifying mandatory Article 33 supply chain duty and Article 7(2) ECHA notifications.
Usage: Submit complex article components and substance masses to calculate component-level and article-level concentrations.
Returns: JSON object with { articleName: string, totalCalculatedMassGrams: number, isArticleSubjectToArt33Communication: boolean, isScipNotificationMandatory: boolean, componentAudits: array }.

components.description: Components comprising the article under the O5A principle

componentMassGrams.description: Mass of the component in grams

svhcSubstances.description: Array of SVHC candidate substances identified in this component

massGrams.description: Mass of the SVHC substance in grams within this component

totalArticleMassGrams.description: Total mass of article in grams (defaults to sum of components)

name: reach_svhc_threshold_screener
